## v1.20.9 — Bug-Fix & Polish

### Bug Fixes

- **Mixin robustness** — `EntityMixin.isInvisible` and `MinecraftClientMixin.render` now use `require=0` and a pinned `INVOKE_ASSIGN` injection point so Timer never hard-crashes on mixin failures.
- **MC 1.21.11 `EntityPositionS2CPacket`** — Position field moved to an `EntityPosition` component in this version; VanishTrackingMixin now calls `packet.change().position()` instead of defunct x/y/z fields.
- **Alt-switching in production** — Added `MinecraftClientAccessor` mixin (loom-remapped to `field_1726`) so session swapping works in the obfuscated runtime. Reflection fallback retained with both yarn and intermediary names.
- **InventoryMove / AutoWalk keybind rebind support** — Added `KeyBindingAccessor` mixin so movement modules respect user-remapped keys instead of always reading the default binding.
- **CompanionServer hardening** — Wildcard CORS header removed (prevented cross-origin API key theft). JSON fields parsed via type-safe helpers. `chatHistory` concurrent reads/writes synchronized. Executor shut down cleanly on client exit.
- **AIClient secrets** — API keys are now redacted from all error messages surfaced to the user.
- **NewChunks renderer** — Unsynchronized iteration of `synchronizedSet` replaced with a snapshot copy inside a `synchronized` block.

### UI / UX

- **ClickGUI panels start open** — Default layout changed from collapsed to open. Panels are arranged in a 7-column grid (CHAT + UTILITY stacked, EXPLOIT + WORLD stacked, COMBAT / MISC / MOVEMENT / RENDER / PLAYER each in their own column) so no panels overlap out of the box.
- **Companion version badge** — Updated to v1.20.9.
